topic: What Jeff Bezos Really Thinks About Elon Musk

youtube.title: What Jeff Bezos Really Thinks About Elon Musk
youtube.description:
What Jeff Bezos really thinks about Elon Musk: he thinks Elon is the hare, and skipping steps does not make you faster.

Bezos almost never says the name. He built Blue Origin as the tortoise against SpaceX, protested Pad 39A, sued NASA after Starship won the 2021 Moon lander, flew New Glenn in 2025, watched a pad explode in May 2026, then posted a tortoise after Musk pivoted to a Moon city.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story.

Same face as the real public figure, still flat 2D cartoon, not a photograph. No on-image text. No historical personal names.
